cellplm_20230926_documented.corpus: 11.4 million unlabeled human scRNA/snRNA and single-cell-resolution CosMx profiles; paper names source groups but does not bind the released object to an immutable 484-dataset and cell roster

cellplm_20231027_registered.corpus: configuration retains the same 19,374-gene, 484-dataset, and 12,596-batch footprint, but exact training provenance is not documented

interpretation: Both current Dropbox revision timestamps predate GSE289173 by more than fifteen months, so its features and target labels were unexposed. This chronology does not make either checkpoint eligible. Checkpoint terms are undeclared, SHA-256 values are unresolved, and the census currently names an undocumented plain-VAE variant instead of the repository-documented Gaussian-mixture release.

preprocessing_and_evaluation_incidents.finding: The paper requires library-size normalization plus log1p, whereas the released pipeline only applies log1p internally and does not establish whether incoming AnnData is raw or normalized.
CellEmbeddingPipeline.score searches Leiden resolutions using the evaluation labels and reports the best ARI/NMI.
The released annotation tutorial concatenates train and test data before the pipeline selects HVGs, and the pipeline performs HVG selection before applying its split field.

CellPLM embeddings depend on every other cell in the transformer context. If batch labels are absent, the released dataset treats all input cells as one sample; changing inference batch size also changes context.

remaining_blockers: Obtain explicit checkpoint terms; BSD-2-Clause repository code is not assumed to license separately hosted Dropbox weights or derivatives.

Freeze state-dict keys, shapes, dtypes, the exact 19,374-gene order, and reconcile that universe with the paper's 13,500 common scRNA genes.
Recover the exact 484-dataset accession/alias and retained-cell inventory for pre-checkpoint development cohorts.
